Free access varies by provider

This is a curated directory, not literally every AI tool on the internet. Free plans, credits, sign-in requirements, regions, model names and prices can change. Some services are paid, some offer limited free credits, and some are free software that may need your own computer or paid cloud hosting. Credit counts are not live-synced to provider accounts. WORKFLOW BUILDER

Viral Short Video

A practical sequence you can use with free or paid external AI tools.

  1. Choose a specific audience and topic.
  2. Write a strong first-second hook.
  3. Plan scenes, narration and on-screen text.
  4. Generate clips with your chosen AI video tool.
  5. Edit, add sound, and review before posting.
Workflow templates and prompt building are free. AI generation, exports, credits and commercial-use rights depend on the external provider you choose.

✦ Quick Creator Tips

Small habits that improve results across many AI tools.

Be specificState the formatDescribe camera motionKeep characters consistentCheck usage rightsReview before publishing

For video, specify aspect ratio, duration, camera movement, lighting, action, sound and continuity. For logos, describe the brand, audience, colors, shape and where the logo will be used.
